fixtures.test: deliberate future-feature leakage fixture is rejected by cutoff filtering
fixtures.purpose: A later unavailable bar is made strongly profitable; the prior decision must remain unchanged because features are filtered by availableAt.

fixtures.test: unresolved split-like discontinuity is excluded for unadjusted data
fixtures.purpose: A 4:1 discontinuity in an unadjusted series without event metadata must fail data integrity instead of becoming a return.

fixtures.test: breakout references exclude the current bar
fixtures.purpose: The current high is extreme; the range test uses only the preceding 20 highs and still evaluates the close against that frozen range.

fixtures.test: missing or zero volume cannot pass
fixtures.purpose: A zero in the preceding volume reference produces a feature exclusion rather than an issued breakout.

tests: crypto availability skips the adjacent open that precedes publication
equity entry uses a later eligible XNYS open
fixtures.purpose: Entry is strictly after decision availability on the appropriate market calendar.

fixtures.test: purges validation labels that overlap the next boundary
fixtures.purpose: A validation decision whose label becomes available in the next period is purged.
